stories.title: Congress proposes four-point formula for delimitation
stories.summary: The Congress party has proposed a four-point formula for delimitation, including retaining 543 Lok Sabha seats and reserving one-third for women. The party accused the government of failing to engage the Opposition on the matter, despite citing the pressing need for consensus under Article 82.

stories.title: Court rejects anticipatory bail pleas in sting case
stories.summary: A Bengaluru court rejected anticipatory bail applications for six individuals, including expelled Congress leader Kripa Alva, regarding an alleged sting operation targeting former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah. A separate plea from a television channel owner remains pending. The city police had opposed the requests.

stories.title: Former CEC warns of institutional strain
stories.summary: Former Chief Election Commissioner S.Y. Quraishi warned that the credibility of the Election Commission of India may take decades to repair. Speaking in Delhi, he argued that constitutional institutions require stronger safeguards against the misuse of power, noting that credibility has been under strain since 2019.

stories.title: Chief Minister promises action on political violence
stories.summary: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan promised strict action against those responsible for alleged attacks on Youth Congress workers and police atrocities during the previous government. He stated that his administration would pursue these cases without compromise, thanking party workers for their role in bringing the government to power.

stories.title: Opposition leaders meet to discuss alliance
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav met with CPI(ML) and AAP leaders this week, fuelling speculation about a wider Opposition coalition ahead of the Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. The SP and Congress are scheduled to discuss seat-sharing arrangements on November 23.

stories.title: Former judge claims removal proceedings are infructuous
stories.summary: Justice Yashwant Varma informed the Lok Sabha Secretary General that proceedings to remove him from the Allahabad High Court are now infructuous following his resignation. The inquiry began after burnt cash was discovered at his residence. He continues to reiterate his innocence regarding the currency found.

stories.title: BJP suffers setbacks in Rajasthan local elections
stories.summary: The ruling BJP faced significant losses in Rajasthan's Panchayati Raj elections, with the Congress party securing leads in 25 of 37 zila parishads. Independent candidates and smaller parties also performed well. The results follow counting held on Friday, ahead of the government's third anniversary.

stories.title: Congress sweeps Rajasthan rural body elections
stories.summary: The Congress party won 548 of 911 zila parishad seats and over half of the declared panchayat samiti seats in Rajasthan. Political analysts described the results as an indication of rural discontent with the ruling BJP government, which is approaching its third year in office.

stories.title: Data journalist profiles Indian political history
stories.summary: Nishant Ranjan has compiled datasets covering 717 chief ministers, 3,350 council of ministers members, and 279 Supreme Court judges since 1952. A mining engineer by training, he has spent the last three years creating original datasets to profile India's political and judicial figures.

stories.title: Supreme Court declines separate recall hearing
stories.summary: Chief Justice of India Surya Kant declined a request for a separate hearing on an application to recall an order regarding the 2023 election commissioners' appointment law. The plea will instead be heard by the existing five-judge Constitution bench already assigned to the matter.

stories.title: TDP-led alliance wins majority of local posts
stories.summary: The TDP-led coalition in Andhra Pradesh won over 93 percent of mandal parishad president posts and 91 percent of vice-president positions. The results, declared by the state election commission, precede the zilla parishad polls scheduled for today.

stories.title: Congress leader alleges stalled investigation
stories.summary: Senior Congress leader Veerappa Moily alleged that party members stalled an investigation that could have led to the arrest of Narendra Modi when he was Gujarat Chief Minister. Moily, who served as Union Law Minister from 2009 to 2011, claimed the move prevented Modi's externment.

stories.title: Manipur district issues liquor advisory
stories.summary: The Chandel district administration issued an advisory to report the sale of adulterated liquor after 11 people died from consuming spurious alcohol. The Chief Minister's Office reported that 180 others are currently receiving treatment at private hospitals in Imphal.

stories.title: Core sector growth hits series-high
stories.summary: Growth in core industrial sectors reached 10.9 percent in October 2026, surpassing the previous high of 8.2 percent set in September. Official data attributes the surge to electricity, coal, cement, and iron ore production, alongside a low base effect from the previous year.

stories.title: High Court orders probe into disputed will
stories.summary: The Madras High Court ordered a CB-CID probe into a lawyer's claim that he was appointed executor of a will by the late wife of a former DGP. The court directed the police to register an FIR and investigate the genuineness of the document.

stories.title: Renovation to disrupt traffic for months
stories.summary: Major renovation work on the Ranigunj Railway Under Bridge will restrict traffic on MG Road for six to eight months starting Saturday. Only one carriageway will remain open to light vehicles, with heavy transport diverted to alternative routes to manage expected congestion.

stories.title: Police restructuring creates uneven divisions
stories.summary: The restructuring of the Bengaluru City Police into five parts has resulted in an uneven distribution of stations, with some divisions left underutilised while others face increased burdens. The new Peenya division currently supervises only four police stations, leading to questions regarding the rationale of the grouping.

stories.title: Man arrested for murder of grandmother
stories.summary: Police arrested a 20-year-old man for allegedly killing his grandmother after she refused to share money received from the Gruha Lakshmi scheme. The suspect confessed to strangling the woman at a temple after she declined his repeated demands for cash.

stories.title: Samajwadi Party workers and driver arrested after fatal bulldozer incident
stories.summary: Four Samajwadi Party workers and a JCB driver were arrested following the death of a 14-year-old boy in Gorakhpur. The boy was run over by a machine arranged for a party roadshow on November 18. Police have brought murder charges against the accused following an investigation.

stories.title: D-Company operative killed in police encounter near Bulandshahr
stories.summary: Naseem Durrani, a 37-year-old wanted for two murders in Delhi, was shot dead by Uttar Pradesh and Delhi police. Durrani, who carried a 50,000 rupee reward, was allegedly linked to the D-Company. The encounter occurred near Bulandshahr during the night of Thursday and Friday.

stories.title: Two killed in bus and tanker collision on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway
stories.summary: Two people died and 47 were injured after a bus carrying 49 wedding guests collided with a tanker near Derol on Friday morning. The bus was traveling from Dhoraji to Surat. Emergency teams responded to the site of the collision around 5.30 am.

stories.title: Police report firing at realtor's office in Delhi
stories.summary: Two unidentified individuals on a scooter fired three rounds at a property dealer's office in Vishwas Nagar on Thursday night. No injuries were reported, though the office glass doors were damaged. Police are investigating the incident, which occurred while several people were inside the building.

stories.title: Gangster linked to D-Company killed in police encounter
stories.summary: Naseem Durrani, a Ghaziabad resident wanted in over 25 criminal cases, was killed in an encounter with the Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force and Delhi Crime Branch. Police stated he was allegedly assigned to kill Chhota Rajan while in Tihar jail.

stories.title: Uddhav Sena leader assaults civic official in Amravati
stories.summary: An Uddhav Sena leader was recorded assaulting a civic official at the municipal office in Amravati. The incident involved verbal confrontation followed by a physical strike to the official's head.

stories.title: APSRTC official urges managers to improve asset protection
stories.summary: APSRTC Joint Managing Director M. Siva Prasad has directed Depot Managers to take personal responsibility for protecting corporate assets and preventing revenue leakages. He stated that depots play a key role in the organization's overall efficiency, financial performance, and service quality.

stories.title: Andhra Loyola College hosts industry interaction
stories.summary: Andhra Loyola College organized a session with HR representatives from 19 organizations to discuss job opportunities and workplace expectations. Principal Fr. S. Melchior emphasized the need for practical industrial exposure and workplace guidance to improve the employability of students.

stories.title: KPTCL implements integrated cybersecurity for power grid
stories.summary: KPTCL has launched an operational technology cybersecurity program to protect its power transmission network. The framework will cover 1,474 substations and six load dispatch centers. Officials noted that modern substations rely on digital systems, making them vulnerable to disruptions beyond traditional IT networks.

stories.title: Traders body projects 7.5 lakh crore business for wedding season
stories.summary: The Confederation of All India Traders expects 52 lakh marriages between November 21 and December 15. The 25-day season is projected to generate 7.5 lakh crore rupees in business across retail, hospitality, and other sectors, averaging over two lakh weddings per day.

stories.title: Twenty-five companies selected for Gwalior Telecom Manufacturing Zone
stories.summary: Twenty-five companies received letters of intent to establish units in Gwalior's Telecom Manufacturing Zone. The government announced the development four months after the initial deal was signed. The ministry of communications did not name the companies or provide further details regarding the participants.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu investment agency addresses leak allegations
stories.summary: Guidance Tamil Nadu, the state government's investment promotion agency, has responded to reports regarding the potential leakage of investment secrets. The agency serves as the primary body for facilitating industrial investment within the state.

stories.title: Youth Congress protests at Meta office in Hyderabad
stories.summary: Youth Congress members staged a protest outside Meta's Gachibowli office regarding account restrictions. Video footage shows participants damaging flower pots outside the facility during the demonstration.

stories.title: Gujarat trader reports courier-based financial fraud
stories.summary: A Gujarat trader reported being targeted by a courier network operating from Delhi. The scheme involved a fraudulent entity referred to as the Children Bank of India, which reportedly attempted a 40-lakh rupee deception.

stories.title: Student innovation for coffee harvesting commercialized
stories.summary: Two students from Coimbatore Public School developed a fruit harvesting toolkit for coffee cherries. The device, which uses a hollow pipe and V-shaped blades to collect cherries, has been licensed to a start-up firm for commercial production following a patent application filed in June 2026.

stories.title: UEF and IIT-Madras partner for growth conclave
stories.summary: The United Economic Forum and IIT-Madras signed an agreement to collaborate on the Tamil Nadu Growth Conclave 2026. Scheduled for December 8, the event will focus on 10 sectors including automotive, electronics, and renewable energy to facilitate industry collaboration and investment.

stories.title: CREDAI Chennai to challenge marshland construction restrictions
stories.summary: CREDAI Chennai plans to approach the Supreme Court to contest a one-kilometer construction restriction around the Pallikaranai marshland. The association expressed disappointment with the Madras High Court decision to refer the matter, claiming the restriction impacts developers and over one lakh residents.

stories.title: Kerala appoints committee to investigate air quality data
stories.summary: The Kerala government has formed an expert committee to assess air quality following conflicting data reported for Kochi and Thiruvananthapuram. The committee, which includes researchers from TERI and NIT Calicut, is tasked with evaluating pollution levels and recommending mitigation measures.

stories.title: Mining waste dump collapses in Chhattisgarh
stories.summary: A mining waste dump operated by state-run NMDC collapsed in the Bailadila hills on Wednesday, spreading debris across forest land and burying thousands of trees. Authorities confirmed no loss of life occurred during the incident. The waste remains on the forest floor, pending further action from district officials.

stories.title: Forest land cleared of encroachment in Mahanadi source area
stories.summary: A joint team of forest department, police, and district administration personnel cleared 102.45 hectares of encroached reserve forest land in the Udanti-Sitanadi Tiger Reserve. The operation involved over 400 personnel and resulted in the removal of nearly one lakh trees planted by encroachers. The land is now cleared.

stories.title: House panel dissatisfied with Green India Mission progress
stories.summary: The Public Accounts Committee expressed dissatisfaction with the National Mission for a Green India, noting the programme has achieved only 5% of its targets since launching in 2014. Panel chairman KC Venugopal reviewed the audit of the mission, which was designed to expand India's forest and tree cover.

stories.title: Environmental groups oppose private recruitment for forest protection
stories.summary: Environmental organisations have urged the Tamil Nadu government to withdraw plans to outsource the recruitment of 293 forest protection staff, including anti-poaching watchers, to private agencies. Critics argue the move could undermine wildlife protection efforts in the Mudumalai Tiger Reserve. The tender process remains under scrutiny by local groups.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu orders fencing for abandoned quarries
stories.summary: The state government has ordered the installation of 1.5-metre-high barbed wire fencing around all abandoned quarries to prevent accidental falls. The Director of Geology and Mining cited recent deaths in deep excavations as a matter of grave concern. The order applies to both government and patta lands.

stories.title: Chennai corporation issues de-occupation notices to coastal buildings
stories.summary: The Greater Chennai Corporation has issued 124 de-occupation notices to coastal buildings found to have major planning violations. The move follows a High Court order regarding unauthorised construction and deviations from Coastal Regulation Zone norms. Owners have been given three months to rectify deviations in some pending appeal cases.

stories.title: Anbumani Ramadoss calls for Pallikaranai marshland protection
stories.summary: PMK president Anbumani Ramadoss has demanded the state government notify all wetlands by January and halt construction projects near the Pallikaranai marshland. He specifically requested the demolition of a three-kilometre compound wall and a two-kilometre walkway. The Madras High Court recently directed the matter to the Supreme Court.

stories.title: Wayanad to become India's first e-waste-free district
stories.summary: Wayanad is set to be declared India's first e-waste-free district on November 27 following a month-long collection campaign. Local bodies and the Haritha Karma Sena will be honoured for their participation. Officials are now preparing a new blueprint to make the district plastic-free as well.

stories.title: Nikhil Gupta sentenced to 235 months in US prison
stories.summary: A U.S. court sentenced Indian national Nikhil Gupta to 235 months in prison for his role in a murder-for-hire plot targeting a Sikh separatist in New York. Gupta pleaded guilty to conspiracy and money laundering charges. He will face deportation following the completion of his prison term.

stories.title: Lufthansa to cut 1,000 jobs amid rising costs
stories.summary: Lufthansa plans to cut 1,000 full-time jobs in Frankfurt and Munich as fuel costs from the Iran war contribute to monthly losses of 20 million euros. The airline stated that previous cost-cutting measures are no longer sufficient to stem losses. Turnaround efforts are currently moving slower than expected.

stories.title: NIA seeks UAE documents, permission to question individuals in Flydubai hijacking attempt probe
stories.summary: Neeraj Chauhan is a senior journalist with Hindustan Times and an investigative reporter specialising in national security, terrorism, organised crime, narcotics, corruption, financial crime and complex investigations. With over 21 years of experience across Hindustan Times, The Times of India, The Indian Express and The Pioneer, he has built deep

stories.title: Dhaka accused of stalling former PM's return
stories.summary: Bangladesh is reportedly insisting on the extradition of former premier Sheikh Hasina to delay her return from India. Hasina, who has lived in India since August 2024, submitted a second passport request after authorities questioned her initial application. India maintains it has created no impediments to her voluntary return.

stories.title: Fugitive deported from UAE for exploitation of women
stories.summary: Mohd Mazin, a fugitive wanted by Maharashtra Police for the alleged sexual and financial exploitation of 14 women, was deported from the UAE. The operation was coordinated by the CBI following the issuance of an Interpol Red Notice. The accused is now in custody to face pending charges.

stories.title: Canada names Goldy Brar in most-wanted list
stories.summary: Canadian authorities have named gangster Satinderjeet Singh, known as Goldy Brar, as a most-wanted fugitive under a public safety initiative. A reward of 250,000 Canadian dollars has been offered for information leading to his arrest. Brar is wanted for first-degree murder and conspiracy to commit murder.

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin meet for trilateral summit
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin, and Xi Jinping met in Shenzhen for a 90-minute trilateral summit. The leaders issued a short, four-point declaration on peace and discussed United Nations reform. The meeting produced few concrete outcomes and did not address the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.

stories.title: Indian Man Gets Over 19 Years In US Jail Over Plot To Kill Khalistani Terrorist Gurpatwant Pannun
stories.summary: Nikhil Gupta was targeting Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, who has US and Canadian citizenship.

stories.title: US Navy ship undergoes repairs in India
stories.summary: The USNS Wally Schirra arrived at the Kattupalli shipyard for repairs under the India-US Master Ship Repair Agreement. The Indian government stated the event reflects growing confidence in domestic ship-repair infrastructure. This marks the fifth time a US naval vessel has used the facility for maintenance and logistics.

stories.title: H-1B workers reconsider US residency
stories.summary: A Google software engineer has announced plans to leave the US, citing constant visa rule changes and the difficulty of obtaining permanent residency. The worker described the current environment as a golden prison. Many skilled immigrants are reportedly re-evaluating their long-term prospects amid shifting immigration policies.

stories.title: US considers ban on Chinese car imports
stories.summary: Lawmakers from auto-producing states aim to pass legislation by year-end to block Chinese automakers like BYD and Geely from the US market. The proposed measure seeks to wall off the sector, citing concerns over connected vehicle technology. Details of the bill remain under negotiation.

stories.title: Mexico president travels in economy class
stories.summary: President Claudia Sheinbaum flew economy on a 21-hour journey from Mexico City to Shenzhen aboard China Southern Airlines. The trip included a three-hour stopover in Tijuana. Social media users identified her seat as 33B, turning her travel choice into a notable point of discussion online.

stories.title: Anthropic shares drop after IPO rally
stories.summary: Anthropic shares fell 9 percent after an initial 39 percent surge during Thursday's debut, closing 17 percent higher. The decline followed the exercise of an over-allotment option by underwriters. The company has raised $119.5 billion to date. The market is adjusting to the scale of the listing.

stories.title: Anthropic debut marks historic market entry
stories.summary: Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its November 19 stock market listing, one of the largest in history. President Daniela Amodei stated the technology needs the public's voice rather than their trust. The company faces growing opposition to data center expansion and delays in AI infrastructure projects.

stories.title: Options and leveraged ETFs for Anthropic expected
stories.summary: Investors may gain access to options contracts and 2x ETFs for Anthropic as early as Monday. While these instruments allow for larger bets on the stock, they also magnify potential losses. The company closed its first day of trading at $97.17, up from its $83 IPO price.

stories.title: Physicist questions climate aid effectiveness
stories.summary: Stanford physicist Steven Koonin argued that global emissions continue to rise despite international climate pledges. Speaking at the HT Leadership Summit, he suggested that promised finance for developing nations has failed to materialize. He questioned the overall achievements of the ongoing COP31 conference in Türkiye.

stories.title: IEA warns of long-term shipping disruption
stories.summary: The IEA projects that shipping through the Strait of Hormuz could drop from 20 million barrels a day to under 2 million by 2035 if current crises persist. Countries are expected to invest in alternative pipelines and demand-reduction measures. The disruption remains a significant energy shock.

stories.title: Florida faces flash flood emergency
stories.summary: The National Weather Service issued a flood watch for Brevard and Volusia counties through Friday evening. Saturated ground and record rainfall have forced road closures across Melbourne, Orlando, and Miami. Coastal areas expect several more inches of rain as the state of emergency expands.

stories.title: Gandhi Hospital delivers triplets after non-ART treatment
stories.summary: A couple welcomed triplet boys at Gandhi Hospital after nine years of unsuccessful fertility treatments elsewhere. Doctors used ovulation induction, a non-assisted reproductive method, to achieve the pregnancy. The babies were discharged after spending over a month in the hospital's neonatal unit.

stories.title: India launches bird flu vaccine for poultry
stories.summary: India has unveiled an indigenous H5N1 vaccine for chickens, developed by ICAR-NIHSAD scientists. Priced at 1 to 2 rupees per dose, the vaccine aims to prevent outbreaks and reduce economic losses in the poultry sector. Agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan introduced the product in Bhopal.

stories.title: India seeks medical care for detained officer
stories.summary: India has contacted Qatari authorities regarding the health of Purnendu Tiwari, a former Navy officer detained on espionage charges. Reports indicate the officer was hospitalized. The eight former Navy personnel involved were sentenced to death in 2023, though their sentences were later commuted.

stories.title: President Murmu calls for medical ethics
stories.summary: President Droupadi Murmu urged graduating doctors to prioritize compassion and service to humanity. Speaking at the Atal Bihari Vajpayee Institute of Medical Sciences, she emphasized the need for quality healthcare in remote areas and encouraged graduates to contribute to medical research and innovation.

stories.title: Antimicrobial manufacturing rules proposed
stories.summary: The Union health ministry proposed an amendment requiring antimicrobial manufacturers to obtain central permission before applying for state licenses. The draft notification seeks to classify antimicrobials as new drugs under the 2019 clinical trials rules. The ministry is currently reviewing the proposal.

stories.title: India unveils H5N1 vaccine for poultry
stories.summary: Agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan introduced an indigenous H5N1 vaccine to protect chickens from avian influenza. Developed in Bhopal, the vaccine targets the Clade 2.3.2.1a virus. It is priced at 1 to 2 rupees per dose to help mitigate mortality in poultry flocks.

stories.title: Private hospitals report high C-section rates
stories.summary: Data from 160,000 insurance claims shows that 69 percent of births in private hospitals are performed via Caesarean section. An analysis by Plum Data Labs suggests this rate is at an all-time high for corporate employees. The study examined delivery patterns and out-of-pocket costs.

stories.title: Pregnant woman dies of suspected dengue
stories.summary: A 39-year-old woman died at Coimbatore Medical College Hospital on Thursday after being treated for suspected dengue. She was seven months pregnant and had initially sought care at a private facility before being transferred. Her death has prompted concern among local residents.

stories.title: Kerala CM offers aid for medical negligence case
stories.summary: Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan promised a free prosthetic leg to a 56-year-old man who underwent an amputation following alleged negligence at a government hospital. The patient claimed a delay in diagnosis led to the procedure. Local officials confirmed the government's intervention.

stories.title: Health minister orders surprise hospital inspections
stories.summary: Health minister K. Muraleedharan directed daily surprise inspections at major government hospitals across every district. Officials will monitor staff attendance, punctuality, and facility cleanliness. The initiative aims to improve the quality of public healthcare services and ensure better patient outcomes.

stories.title: Thiruvananthapuram MCH to celebrate 75th anniversary
stories.summary: The Government Medical College Hospital in Thiruvananthapuram will host a platinum jubilee convention from November 20 to 22. The event, themed to honour the past and shape the future, features an academic conclave on healthcare trends. The institution is currently marking 75 years of operation.

stories.title: NASA director shares path from high school dropout to space agency
stories.summary: Dr. Tanya Rogers, currently an Energy Systems Director at NASA, left high school to work as a waitress before pursuing higher education. She earned a PhD from Rice University while managing an undiagnosed illness. Her career trajectory is being cited as an example of second chances.

stories.title: Los Angeles region records 4.2 magnitude earthquake
stories.summary: A 4.2 magnitude earthquake struck 1 km north-northwest of Commerce, California, at a depth of 16.6 km. It is the 481st local tremor recorded in the past 30 days. Residents reported feeling the shallow quake across the Los Angeles region.

stories.title: CJP launches initiative to promote Gandhi through satire
stories.summary: The Cockroach Janata Party is launching a pan-India initiative titled Legacy of Bapu to promote Mahatma Gandhi’s ideology. The project uses comedy and satire to engage younger generations. The first event is scheduled for November 21 in Pune, requiring official passes for entry.

stories.title: Mammootty returns to Tamil cinema in Operation Mole
stories.summary: Director Rajkumar Periasamy released the action film O.M Operation Mole on November 20. The production features a large ensemble cast, including Dhanush and Sai Pallavi. Mammootty’s role marks his first appearance in a Tamil film in seven years.

stories.title: Operation Mole review: A familiar action thriller
stories.summary: Director Rajkumar Periasamy’s latest film follows an undercover officer pursuing a smuggling network. The plot mirrors the structure of the 2025 film Dhurandhar, shifting the setting from Pakistan to Chennai. The film features performances by Dhanush, Sai Pallavi, and Mammootty.

stories.title: Sathyavan Savithri review: Courtroom drama draws on mythology
stories.summary: Debutant director Praveen S Vijaay’s courtroom drama draws parallels to the Mahabharata tale of Savitri and Yama. Keerthy Suresh stars as a junior advocate facing off against a senior lawyer played by Mysskin. The film attempts to use judicial rules to mirror mythological outcomes.

stories.title: Bachelor Party D’eux movie review: Amal Neerad makes a sequel almost as forgettable as the original
stories.summary: The thought of making a sequel for a film usually crosses the minds of the makers when the first one is a successful outing and there are interesting elements left to explore. Considering that Bachelor Party (2012) was largely a dud, barring a few passable sequences, the decision to make

stories.title: Indian Coffee House maintains its architectural legacy
stories.summary: The Indian Coffee House in Thiruvananthapuram continues to operate within its red-brick tower designed by architect Laurie Baker. The structure features brick benches and tables illuminated by jaalis. The setting remains largely unchanged despite the passage of time.

events.line: IGBC's annual congress at Jio World Convention Centre.

events.line: TiE's global gathering of founders and investors.
